entry_point_selection.title: Entry-point selection
entry_point_selection.description: One selector chooses the run mode (set exactly one). Requiredness and mutual-exclusivity are enforced in the workflow body, not here.

input.description: Validated samplesheet CSV (primary input). fastq profile (sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,run) runs Part A; fasta profile (sample,fasta,qual,stats) runs Part B.
input.help_text: Mutually exclusive with the folder-scan inputs (--fastq_folder / --fasta_folder / --occurrence_table).

fastq_folder.description: Input fastq directory (one or more, comma-separated); runs Part A and, when --project_name is also set, Part B.

fasta_folder.description: Per-sample .fas + .qual + .stats directory; runs Part B standalone.

occurrence_table.description: Part B's <basename>_table.tsv; runs Part C standalone.

outdir.description: Single root for all published outputs (<outdir>/{per_sample,occurrence_table,pipeline_info}/). Defaults to --results_folder, then 'results'.

results_folder.description: Deprecated alias for --outdir. (Not flagged with the schema `deprecated` keyword: nf-schema treats that as a hard rejection, but the alias is still supported — validate_params() emits the deprecation warning instead.)

part_a.title: Part A — fastq to per-sample fasta
part_a.description: Read merging, primer trimming, per-sample fasta conversion.

forward_primer.description: IUPAC forward primer. Required unless --no_trimming, and IUPAC-validated, in the workflow body (Phase 1: the pattern stays in Groovy check_primer_format so it cannot pre-empt that message).

reverse_primer.description: IUPAC reverse primer. Required unless --no_trimming, and IUPAC-validated, in the workflow body (Phase 1: the pattern stays in Groovy check_primer_format so it cannot pre-empt that message).

recover_unmerged.description: Opt in to the experimental shadow pipeline that recovers unmergeable read pairs by A-padded joining.
recover_unmerged.help_text: Off by default; when off, unmergeable pairs are dropped and no _notmerged artefacts are produced. The --stripright / --join_padding_length knobs only apply when this is set.

stripright.description: 3' nt trimmed in the shadow pipeline before R1/R2 are joined (0 disables).

join_padding_length.description: Length of the A run inserted between R1 and R2 by the shadow pipeline's vsearch --fastq_join (and its matching Phred-40 quality string).

part_b.title: Part B — per-sample fasta to occurrence table

project_name.description: Basename prefix for Part B output (required when Part B runs, enforced in the workflow body).

fastidious.help_text: Set false on very large datasets where the fastidious pass is too memory- or time-expensive.

percentage.description: Cleaving threshold: a sub-seed candidate must appear as a per-sample cluster seed in at least this fraction of samples; real in (0, 1].

reference_dataset.description: stampa-formatted reference fasta (.gz / .bz2 OK). Required when --taxonomy_method=stampa (default).

reference_dataset_sintax.description: sintax-formatted reference fasta (.gz / .bz2 OK). Required when --taxonomy_method=sintax; gates the shadow Part C path.

taxonomy_method.description: Regular-path method. The shadow path always uses sintax regardless of this flag.

stampa_chunk_size.description: Sequences per stampa scatter chunk; 0 disables the split.

stampa_maxrejects.description: vsearch --maxrejects for the stampa scatter step; 0 = no limit.

stampa_id.description: vsearch --id threshold for the stampa scatter step.

sintax_cutoff.description: vsearch --sintax_cutoff threshold; used by the shadow path and by --taxonomy_method=sintax on the regular path.

majority_assignment.description: Opt-in final step: recompute a majority-rule taxonomy per OTU and publish <basename>_table_assigned_majority.tsv. Requires --taxonomy_method=stampa.

publish_mode.description: publishDir mode. Use 'copy' when the results folder is on a different filesystem than the work directory.

help.description: Show the usage message and exit.

slurm_profile.title: Slurm profile
slurm_profile.description: Only consulted under -profile slurm. Submission/queue knobs and resource size hints.

slurm_clusterOptions.description: Extra sbatch options appended verbatim to every job's submit line (QoS, constraints, reservations).

dataset_size_gb.description: Approximate input dataset size in GB; the memory-bound steps scale off this.

reference_size_gb.description: Approximate reference-database size in GB; the taxonomic-assignment steps scale off this.

max_memory.description: resourceLimits memory ceiling (quoted Nextflow units, e.g. '256.GB').

max_time.description: resourceLimits wall-time ceiling (quoted Nextflow units, e.g. '120.h').

modules_profile.title: Modules profile
modules_profile.description: Only consulted under -profile modules. Site-specific environment-module names; empty means 'already on PATH'.
